preconditions.description: The input must be a string.
The length of the input string must be between 0 and 1000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the count of palindromic substrings as a string.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for i in range(len(s)) for j in range(i, len(s)) if s[i:j+1] == s[i:j+1][::-1])
postconditions.description: The return value must be the total number of palindromic substrings in the input string.
